lesson.title: 三角函数与图像：章开篇

en.title: Trigonometric Functions and Graphs: Chapter Opening

concepts.title: 周期函数与周期
concepts.summary: 周期函数满足 $f(x+T)=f(x)$；最小正T称基本周期。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先找曲线完整重复的最小水平距离，核对变量单位。

en.title: Periodic functions and period
en.summary: A periodic function satisfies $f(x+T)=f(x)$; the least positive T is its fundamental period.

method.title: Method
method.body: Find the smallest complete horizontal repetition and check the variable’s unit.

concepts.title: 正弦曲线
concepts.summary: 正弦与余弦及其伸缩平移形成正弦曲线，可近似描述自然周期模式。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 本章依次学习基本图像(5.1)、变换(5.2)、正切(5.3)、方程与建模(5.4)。

en.title: Sinusoidal curve
en.summary: Sine/cosine and their scalings/translations form sinusoidal curves that can approximate natural periodic patterns.

method.title: Method
method.body: Study basic graphs(5.1), transformations(5.2), tangent(5.3), then equations and models(5.4).

concepts.title: 振幅
concepts.summary: 正弦曲线中线到极值的竖直距离，等于最大最小差的一半。

en.title: Amplitude
en.summary: The vertical distance from midline to an extremum, half the maximum–minimum difference.

concepts.title: 竖直平移
concepts.summary: 中线相对x轴的竖直位移。

en.title: Vertical displacement
en.summary: The vertical position of the sinusoidal axis relative to the x-axis.

concepts.title: 相移
concepts.summary: 曲线相对基本正弦或余弦的水平平移。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 角先写成 $b(x-c)$，有向相移c；不要把未提出b的常数直接当c。

en.title: Phase shift
en.summary: Horizontal translation relative to a basic sine or cosine.

method.title: Method
method.body: Factor the argument as $b(x-c)$; signed shift is c, not the unfactored argument constant.

concepts.title: 本章目标与职业联系
concepts.summary: 本章学习按固定间隔重复取值的三角函数，描述自然中的波与周期模式，包括岩层褶皱、运动和季节。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 地质学家综合物理、化学、生物与数学研究地球的结构历史；地质工程将知识用于坝、隧道和建筑。原开篇无准备题，职业网站属于外部延伸，未作为已核实题目。

en.title: Chapter aims and career context
en.summary: This chapter studies trigonometric functions with values that repeat at regular intervals and models waves/periodic patterns, including rock folds, motion, and seasons.

method.title: Method
method.body: Geologists combine physics, chemistry, biology, and mathematics to study Earth’s structure/history; geological engineering applies this to dams, tunnels, and buildings. The opening has no preparation questions; its career website is external enrichment rather than a verified textbook exercise.
